newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia calls for dialogue among Serbia foes.
newsitem.headline: Russia calls for dialogue among Serbia foes.

text.p: Russia on Wednesday called for a dialogue to solve the political crisis in Yugoslavia and said third parties should not interfere.

"The current crisis can and must be solved through a political dialogue among all democratic forces," the Foreign Ministry said in a statement. "Violence and actions which could lead to clashes and confrontation should be ruled out."

"We deem inadmissible any outside interference in the internal affairs of the Serbian people," the short statement added in a clear reference to moral support given to the Zajedno (Together) opposition by the West.
Zajedno has held 35 days of protests since the socialist government of President Slobodan Milosevic last month annulled municipal election defeats in Belgrade and 14 other towns.
Street fighting broke out during a socialist protest against the Zajedno demonstrations on Tuesday.
Zajedno leaders have reprimanded Russia for implicitly backing Milosevic in his confrontation with the opposition.
